level.description: The offered level: a `Fraction` under a rate term, a count under a count term

metric.description: What is measured. Core terms below. A receiver that doesn't know the term skips the line item (§ 2.2): a tuple binds outside any option

counted_by.description: Who counts. When `channel` is `dooh` and the line item counts impressions, `counted_by` MUST be the source of the line item's `delivery_counting.impression_multiplier`. When the `pricing[]` entry the buyer commits under has `cost_method` `CPP`, `counted_by` MUST be its `cost_parameters.rating_source`

discrepancy_threshold.description: A fraction of the controlling count. When the other measurement, a party's own count of the same units, exceeds the controlling count by more than this over an invoice period, reconciliation opens

final_after.description: Such as `P30D` (30 days). A count is final that long after its invoice period ends. Committed values, whichever source measures them, are final that long after `commitment.flight.end`

qualifier.description: A product or method of `counted_by`, such as a named ad server
